scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the active SpinCycle laundry-card top-up so the washer load queued for the basement machines can run today.
Emerging Need: The top-up begins with a wallet charge and pending card write, then that same transaction stops on a kiosk write error with self-service retry disabled.
Decision Context: Observable records show the receipt, lock, queue cutoff, and short machine availability; the stored laundry-cost note supplies the card ID, intake route, and no auto-reload or replacement-fee preference.
Consequence: Timely documentation can preserve today’s load; after the queue closes, the charge remains unresolved and the laundry cannot start today.

parameter.title: Top up laundry card before basement washer slot
parameter.content: Add enough value to the laundry card before the midday basement-machine opening.

parameter.description: Laundry-card top-up initiated at the co-op basement kiosk; card credit not yet confirmed.

parameter.body: Your $6.00 laundry-card top-up was accepted at the basement kiosk. Receipt SC-LD-20261125-1184 is writing the credit to the card; keep the same session open until the completion notice appears.

parameter.content: South washer just opened. I can keep the shelf clear for your basket until about 1:20, then I need to move my things back.

parameter.subject: Action stopped for top-up SC-LD-20261125-1184
parameter.body: Top-up SC-LD-20261125-1184 hit a kiosk card-write error after payment capture. The credit is not on the laundry card, and self-service retry is disabled while locked ticket LQ-5826 is in review. Same-day manual release remains available only for documented account and card details received before the 1:05 PM support queue cutoff.

parameter.subject: Top-up SC-LD-20261125-1184 rolled to next service day
parameter.body: Locked ticket LQ-5826 did not receive same-day manual-release documentation before the 1:05 PM queue cutoff. The $6.00 charge remains under review, no credit has been written to the laundry card, and the next release batch is scheduled for Thursday morning.
